occupations.title: Human Resources Managers
occupations.rationale: The product is an all-in-one HCM platform designed to simplify HR, is marketed to "HR pros," and is explicitly used by HR Directors and People Managers [D:Namely:landing:1, D:Namely:landing:4, D:Namely:landing:12, D:Namely:landing:13].

occupations.title: Payroll and Timekeeping Clerks
occupations.rationale: The software provides core features for "Payroll & Time," "Time-Tracking," and "Managed Payroll" to speed processing, ensure accuracy, and eliminate the burden of daily payroll administration [D:Namely:landing:2, D:Namely:landing:4, D:Namely:landing:6, D:Namely:landing:8].

occupations.title: Compensation and Benefits Managers
occupations.rationale: The platform offers enhanced modules and managed services for "Benefits" and "Benefits Administration," and is praised by users for enabling better decision-making around benefits [D:Namely:landing:3, D:Namely:landing:7, D:Namely:landing:9, D:Namely:landing:12].
